text:
Nadia: quick question for the group
Our marketplace HW partner (Helix) wants their private-offer to include a hardware credit tied to committed spend. debate: wallet top-up vs invoice credit. pros/cons? :thinking_face:
Tom: wallet top-up reduces manual billing ops (credits auto-applied) but Finance will treat as deferred revenue liability. invoice credit is simpler for rev rec but more manual reconciliation.
Ravi: from SI quoting perspective, invoice credit is easier to show on paper. resellers hate opaque wallets. also want the offer to include a public SKU for quoting: `redwood.marketplace:helix-commit-v1`.
Hannah: product perspective 0% agree with Ravi on visibility. if we do wallet, let's include a clean line item in billing UI so SIs and customers see wallet balance + expiry.
frank-finance: finance take: invoice-credit preferred. if wallet, we need clear accounting treatment and a maximum wallet lifespan (suggest 12 months). Activation floor: we want to avoid <$60k ARR deals filling ops. recommend $80k ARR activation threshold.
Nadia: noted. legal wants a clawback if customer terminates early. propose prorated clawback over first 90 days with option to net against future invoices.
Tom: ops/eng asks: marketplace private-offer payload needs fields: partner_id, partner_sku, commit_amount_usd, activation_floor_usd, credit_type ("invoice"|"wallet"), credit_amount_usd, credit_expiry_days, clawback_days, restricted_listing_bool. will file spec in eng-catalog board.
Ravi: SI enablement: include a 1-page co-sell checklist and a fillable template email for SIs. also request that marketplace private-offer page includes a link to the co-sell asset.
Hannah: launch timeline idea: T-21 partner onboarding & finance sign-off, T-14 engineering spec merged, T-7 pilot with Helix-managed customer, T = live listing + joint PR. keep pilot short to validate billing flow.
frank-finance: add a finance checkpoint at T-10 to confirm posting rules and SKU mapping.
pm-bot: meeting "Helix Private Offer Kickoff" created for T-21. invites sent to partnerships, finance, legal, eng-catalog, eng-billing, SI-leads.
Nadia: action items: frank to confirm invoice vs wallet preference by EOD, Tom to draft API fields, Ravi to prepare SI quote sample, Hannah to draft customer-facing listing copy. i'll collate and post ADO card.
frank-finance: will reconfirm by EOD; leaning invoice-credit with 12m expiry if wallet used.
Tom: filing spec now, will tag eng-catalog and eng-billing for review.
Ravi: gathering SI quote examples, pinging two partners for pilot intros.
Nadia: thanks team. quick wins then runbook after pilot. :rocket:
